results.name: Title Case: every page's headings and column headers follow the convention, and nothing relies on CSS capitalize
information tips: hover opens and leaving closes; the popup is labelled and described, and shows the glossary wording
information tips: keyboard focus opens, Escape closes, moving focus away closes
information tips: a click outside closes an open tip
information tips on a 375 px touch device: a tap opens, the popup stays inside the viewport, a tap outside closes; reduced motion removes the fade
ticket: the mode switch and the field labels follow the convention, with tips on the concepts that need them
dashboard: Market Board, Market Depth and Order Book carry tips; the last trade price has one
My Orders: a pending stop shows Trigger Price and Limit Price and an amber Pending Trigger badge; a limit order shows only its limit price
semantic badges: Resting, Partially Filled, Filled and Cancelled differ by tone, icon and text, and all are readable (>= 4.5:1)
Eligible Now is a separate chip: the order stays Pending Trigger, escrowed, and is never shown as another status
REGRESSION (order #3 of the Bonus 3 MetaMask run): a stop cancelled in the UI before activation is never described as activated, and keeps its Trigger Price
activated stops: a traded stop says Activated and keeps its Trigger Price; one that rests and is then cancelled by its owner is an owner cancellation
history unreadable: a stop cancelled before activation gets neutral wording and the list still works; it recovers on the next mount
history request economy: none for pending stops, one request for a stable set, nothing on later blocks, one more only when a status changes
account switching: the account chip follows the connected account, My Orders shows only that account's orders, and a review states who sends
the shared primary button (Approve) is readable: at least 4.5:1
layout: no horizontal overflow on any page at 375, 768 and 1280 px
accessibility: axe-core finds no violations in My Orders with stops, the stop ticket review, and the pages, at 1280 and 375 px
